bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New features for seamless app resumption from Android to PC are rolling out.
Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader - Microsoft recognized as a leader for Cloud-Native Application Platforms for the second consecutive year.
Advancements in Quantum Safety - Microsoft is preparing for quantum-safe cryptography to secure future digital infrastructures.
Multi-Agent Intelligence Design - A shift towards modular, task-specialized AI agents is essential for enterprise scalability.
ClickFix Social Engineering Threat - Microsoft highlights the ClickFix technique targeting users to execute malicious commands.
